summary: Submitted draft/submission.json (action=review) for the accepted direct check fe65e174b269433b9d18622001fec470 (version 1) of obligation c-client-request-completes-on-inactive-raft. With both blockers answered, the assessment for this artifact should recompute to a confirmed violated comparison at implementation_obligation level, completing the obligation and turning the conclusion into a confirmed in-scope result.
